subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2705
title: Requires the Higher Education Coordinating Commission, in coordination with public universities and community colleges, to conduct a study to determine the appropriate rate of return the State of Oregon should receive for each patent obtained as a result of public moneys provided to a public university or community college.
headline: HB 2705 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2705 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
HB 2705 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
